create_resize_transform: create a ResizeTransform to resize an image from original dimensions to a target size with bilinear interpolation
create_rotation_transform: create a RotationTransform to rotate an image by a given angle around its center with expand
create_extent_transform: create an ExtentTransform to extract and scale a subregion from a source image to a target output size
create_color_transform: create a ColorTransform to apply a photometric operation to an image without changing coordinates
apply_rotated_box_transforms: apply horizontal flip and resize transforms on rotated bounding boxes in x_center y_center width height angle format
